description: This file defines a React component for a marketplace page in a career development application. It renders various sections like recommended opportunities, skill gaps, and personalized suggestions, utilizing placeholder data and localStorage for state management. The page is designed with accessibility, animation, and UX considerations in mind, and includes various subcomponents such as OpportunityCard and MetricCard.

classes.name: Opportunity
classes.description: TypeScript type defining opportunity items such as courses, internships, projects, mentorship, and certifications.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.description: TypeScript type for milestone objects within a role plan.

classes.name: RolePlan
classes.description: TypeScript type representing a role and its associated plan, milestones, and skill deltas.

classes.name: RoadmapState
classes.description: TypeScript type describing the shape of the roadmap state stored in localStorage.

methods.name: safeParseRoadmapState
methods.description: Parses the JSON string from localStorage safely into RoadmapState or null if invalid.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between two bounds.

methods.name: completionSummary
methods.description: Calculates summary info about milestones based on their status.

methods.name: countSkillGapsFromDeltas
methods.description: Analyzes role deltas to determine progress metrics: completed, in progress, missing skills.

methods.name: usePrefersReducedMotion
methods.description: Custom hook to detect user's reduced motion preference.

methods.name: BadgePill
methods.description: Component for rendering styled badge labels with color coding.

methods.name: MetricCard
methods.description: Component displaying a metric label, value, and status badge.

methods.name: OpportunityCard
methods.description: Component for rendering opportunity item cards, with icons, badges, and hover effects.
